# V1.13.6

Section: Source

**V1.13.6** of *[Stormworks: Build and Rescue](https://stormworks.fandom.com/wiki/Stormworks:_Build_and_Rescue)* was released on February 14th, 2025.

## V1.13.6

- Fix - reverted propeller change due to changing game behavior for some players
- Fix - resolved dropped frames with damage rebuilding
